notes: [Teams] [status email 2026/10/14] Overall status ON-TRACK. Completed: IOSP-1011 (Pure-based backup enabled, ran several days, Earle) and IOSP-1014 (Pure backup confirmed working, Calvin).

[Teams] [rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Earle and Calvin agreed the Pure backup has run several days without issues, so IOSP-1011/IOSP-1014 are passed. Plan was to enable the Rubrik RAC backup Friday 10/16 6 PM UTC.

[Teams] [rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Problem found: Rubrik is only plumbed on the CA backup VLANs (VLAN 130 and 2988), but the RAC nodes only have production/RAC-interconnect addresses (no CA backup VLAN interface on the RAC instance in Secaucus). Agreed the right approach is CA Backup VLAN addressing on the RAC nodes, which requires an RM ticket and a maintenance window on scdpcarac1 (primary production).

[Teams] [rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Revised timing: the VLAN interface change is done in the weekend maintenance (starts 7 PM Eastern / midnight UK, about 30 min), so the Rubrik RAC initial backup moves to Sunday 10/18, proposed start 1 PM UTC (16-hour initial run). Earle expects the interface can be added without a VM restart; Tier 2 secondary on-call Ramana Chowdary expected to assist.

[Teams] [rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Open design question: Rubrik should ideally connect via the RAC SCAN name/VIPs for HA, but those are not on the backup VLAN and Oracle Clusterware does not manage a second VIP. Calvin will not create the RM yet until Oracle and Rubrik replies arrive. Prajeet to raise an Oracle Support ticket; SriChand and Calvin to ask Rubrik Support.

[Teams] [rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Existing RMAN backups on the primary run in parallel with the Rubrik initial run; Earle and Prajeet agreed to let them run together (weekend, low Rubrik channel count). RAC is one shared database with two instances; one host add in Rubrik should be sufficient, to be confirmed with Rubrik docs.

[Teams] [rubrik transcript 2026-10-14] Shipment: Calvin pinged Karl on contract status; contract signature by procurement is the gating item. Hardware is resold via MicroAge but work is done by TechX; two Sectigo people needed in the cage. Appliance prep (new IP per node, shut down, about a dozen nodes) targeted 10/21 (IOSP-1013). Earle: background DBA work (IOSP-1009) could start as early as next week (by 10/23); standby now running in Manchester.

[Teams] [status email 2026/10/14] Timeline: Oct 6-27 prep until appliances ready for pickup (IOSP-1012 RAC backup enable 10/16 6PM UTC Sri; IOSP-880 validate RAC backup/replication 10/17-10/20; IOSP-1013 appliance prep 10/21 Sri/Calvin; IOSP-1010 shipment plan/contracts 10/21-TBD Karl/Calvin/procurement); Oct 27-Nov 9 international shipment (IOSP-1015); Oct 23-Nov 23 background DBA work (IOSP-1009, Earle); Nov 9-16 rack/cable/validate in Manchester (IOSP-1004/1005); Nov 16-Dec 6 commissioning (IOSP-1006); Nov 30-Dec 6 production testing (IOSP-1007); Dec 7 fully production in Europe (IOSP-1008).
[Teams] [status email 2026/10/14] Meeting with Network team planned next week to prepare for Rubrik in Manchester.

[Teams] [rubrik chat 2026-10-15] Calvin: standalone Oracle in SEC is only still alive to support the Rubrik POC, so it can be retired no later than the 1st (Nov 1); Earle: Prajeet agreed to do the work during a SASP maintenance window.

[Teams] [rubrik chat 2026-10-16] Earle noted for the weekend patching: when patching is done, ask Ramana whether the CA backup interfaces are up and post in the Rubrik chat so SriChand can try adding the hosts in Rubrik. Backup will not start until the maintenance window completes, but connectivity can be confirmed during it. Calvin asked when the maintenance window is and whether Oracle will be down; Calvin has another commitment and will watch for updates from Sri.

[Teams] [rubrik chat 2026-10-17] Prajeet: Oracle part is done; pending items are the backup VLAN and Rubrik validation. Also (earlier 10/17 thread) Prajeet doubts Rubrik should need the DB user password, since that defeats the Oracle Credentials Wallet purpose.

[Teams] [rubrik chat 2026-10-14/15] Prajeet: Rubrik/RAC backup IPs do not need to be registered with Oracle Clusterware; node-list ordering and RAC node eligibility handled by Rubrik per docs.rubrik.com 8.0 Oracle backing_up_databases.
